title: How 50,000 People Surged Into a Spanish Exclave in Africa
description: On Thursday, tens of thousands of Moroccans broke into Ceuta, a Spanish territory that neighbors Morocco. By Friday evening, most of them had left, hungry and disappointed.

title: Fifa scraps controversial World Cup investment plan
description: Football's world governing body abandons plans to sell off stakes in its major competitions after widespread opposition to president Gianni Infantino's proposal.

title: SEC and Big Ten agree to support bipartisan college sports bill after tense negotiations
